title: Beyond the Basin
lesson: Expand before finite supplies run out.

objectives.text: Lose all HQs, production structures and engineering rigs.
Control both marked expansion fields before the starting field empties.
Own both military supply stations at victory.
The starting field is exhausted before both expansions are secured.

scenario_exceptions.detail: Finite scripted enemy column 1: 3 rifles; normal adds 1 car, hard also adds 1 tank. Only enemy timing is scaled. Entry (100,52).
Finite scripted enemy column 2: 3 rifles; normal adds 1 car, hard also adds 1 tank. Only enemy timing is scaled. Entry (83,20).
Finite scripted enemy column 3: 3 rifles; normal adds 1 car, hard also adds 1 tank. Only enemy timing is scaled. Entry (100,52).

All mission starting assets are listed in the opening state. Allied recovery transfers existing actors and preserves caps. Scripted enemy columns are finite, announced scenario exceptions; they are not paid AI production.

subtitles.speaker: Commander Arman Vey
subtitles.text: The starting field contains only 6,000 credits. Secure both expansion positions before that finite field empties. This is the only reduced starting-field budget. Capture both military supply stations as an optional achievement.

subtitles.speaker: Operations
subtitles.text: Expand before finite supplies run out.

subtitles.speaker: Watch
subtitles.text: Hostile column 1 is approaching the eastern road. Expected entry varies with difficulty; screen the marked approach.

subtitles.speaker: Watch
subtitles.text: Column 1 has entered. Its approach is east.

subtitles.speaker: Watch
subtitles.text: Hostile column 2 is approaching the northwestern pass. Expected entry varies with difficulty; screen the marked approach.

subtitles.speaker: Watch
subtitles.text: Column 2 has entered. Its approach is northwest.

subtitles.speaker: Watch
subtitles.text: Hostile column 3 is approaching the eastern road. Expected entry varies with difficulty; screen the marked approach.

subtitles.speaker: Watch
subtitles.text: Column 3 has entered. Its approach is east.

subtitles.speaker: Operations
subtitles.text: One expansion is secure. Split protection carefully: the starting reserve is finite.

subtitles.speaker: Commander Arman Vey
subtitles.text: Beyond the Basin is complete. Keep the route secure; the next operation will depend on what we learned here.

subtitles.speaker: Commander Arman Vey
subtitles.text: We can no longer meet this operation’s requirements. Return to the last checkpoint and change the approach.
